note_add: Tax: Sépaq's posted camping rates exclude taxes, which are added at checkout. Park access: in the parcs nationaux every visitor, camper or day visitor, pays the daily access fee on top of the camping fee: $10.30 a day per adult 18 and over (taxes included, valid from May 1, 2026), under 18 free; annual cards are $93 for every national park or $51.50 for one park. The row also covers the réserves fauniques, so the access fee is carried on each parc national entry, not here. Sépaq's camping rules: a site takes 6 people, at most 4 of them adults 18+, and one car parks free; a second car only where the site allows, otherwise in the designated lots. Some parks and site types differ.
